evidence_levels.COMMUNITY: author report or guide; hardware may differ
evidence_levels.BA: Baikal/Pro hardware; a lead, not transferable
evidence_levels.ORBIS-SOURCE: checked by Orbis in the pinned source

entries.title: HDMI alive at 1080p60 but all pixels black after a userspace KMS modeset (MN864729 VMUTE not cleared after disable/enable)
entries.pack_action: 0.2.0 kernel (crashnt-4.7) already removes the in-queue ICC delays that aday1 identified; aday1 reports the prebuilt crashnt-4.7 kernel fixes it on a CUH-12xx. Pack: display.connector/display.link checks + stage-0 connector/EDID capture; opt-in kernel patch kernel/patches/available/0101 adds runtime A/B knobs (defaults = 0.2.0 behaviour).

entries.title: Display manager / X11 / Wayland login black or grey screen; unsupported EDID; hotplug failure
entries.pack_action: stage-0 and qualify record connectors, modes, EDID header validity and link state; Orbis 0001 advertises 1080p60 only (safe fallback).

entries.title: Vulkan geometry/texture corruption while 2D/UI looks fine (RADV on Liverpool 1002:9922)
entries.pack_action: vk.raster pixel oracles (gradient, depth test) + vk.compute numeric oracle; Mesa patch 0005 (RADV meta fill on MUBUF) included; no universal fix known.

entries.title: GPU shows up as software renderer / DRM missing / Liverpool not mapped in libdrm/Mesa/Xorg
entries.pack_action: Mesa patch 0001 adds Liverpool/Gladius families; gl.renderer FAILs on llvmpipe/softpipe; vk.device requires a non-CPU RADV device (driverID 3).

entries.title: Missing/wrong GPU firmware; GFX/SDMA rings fail or time out
entries.pack_action: gpu.firmware lists per-block versions from debugfs (CE PFP ME MEC MEC2 RLC SDMA0 SDMA1); gpu.rings; opt-in gpu.ib_test; pack contains no firmware.

entries.title: Kernel/libdrm/Mesa ABI mismatch after upgrades (5.4 Baikal kernel + newer libdrm)
entries.pack_action: 6.15.4 is not capped at old Mesa; contract documented in GRAPHICS-KERNEL-MESA-COMPATIBILITY.md; build refuses libdrm < 2.4.133.

entries.title: Mesa upgrade regresses: 26.2.5 on Baikal had OpenGL but stalled Vulkan/UVD and was rolled back
entries.pack_action: Two Mesa lines (stable 26.2.5 + pinned main snapshot) and rollback-root.sh back to the 0.2.0 Mesa.

entries.title: Some apps improve with RADV_DEBUG=nocompute or amdgpu.abmlevel=0; WineD3D slow
entries.pack_action: Never global: profiles never set RADV_DEBUG; documented as per-application troubleshooting only (conflicts with GPU compute).

entries.title: DPCD/DP link readiness, HPD polling and clock recovery cause intermittent black screens
entries.pack_action: kernel/candidates.json includes sjd-6.18.21-dprework and feeRnt 6.15.4 branches; research-deltas.sh extracts GPU/bridge diffs for review; nothing applied.

entries.title: Sustained performance depends on SCLK, low-power states, ASPM, IRQs, thermals
entries.pack_action: On the 0.2.0 kernel Liverpool has no powerplay (pp_smu) so there is no DPM/clock control: pm.clocks = UNSUPPORTED with the reason. perf.sustained (opt-in) records frame time drift and CPU temperatures.

entries.title: GPU carve-out competes with Linux RAM in unified GDDR5
entries.pack_action: Profiles only RECOMMEND vram_mb; changing it is the existing explicit 0.2.0 step (orbis boot set-vram, reboot).

entries.title: UVD H.264 decode inconsistent; stalls after upgrades
entries.pack_action: 0.2.0 kernel has the UVD 4.2 / VCE 2.0 IP blocks commented out for Liverpool and the loader does not supply UVD/VCE firmware: video.decode = UNSUPPORTED. feeRnt x_exp__6.15.4-uvd-engine(2) are research candidates.

entries.title: Vulkan/compute may enumerate but miscompute or stall
entries.pack_action: vk.compute integer oracle checked on CPU, cl.rusticl integer kernel checked on CPU, bounded by timeouts; no ROCm dependency.

entries.title: App/peripheral bugs look like GPU bugs (OSD, controller, HDMI audio)
entries.pack_action: qualify keeps GL, Vulkan, compute, video and display checks separate with their own result codes.

entries.title: Newer kernels: experimental 1080p120, HDMI audio, clock controls
entries.pack_action: Opt-in only; not in 1.0.0. Candidates listed in kernel/candidates.json.

entries.title: GPU performance affected by CPU-side disk/IRQ/network load
entries.pack_action: gl.frame_timing reports median and p95; DEGRADED when p95 > 2x median; perf.sustained is opt-in.

entries.title: No HDMI signal can be a physical transmitter/port defect
entries.pack_action: GRAPHICS-HARDWARE-QUALIFICATION.md: check the PS4 menu shows a picture before Linux; stage-0 logs connector status independent of the display.

entries.title: 7.x Baikal GPU improvements are not a drop-in for Belize 6.15.4
entries.pack_action: Compatibility matrix is per target; 7.0-Clean is a research candidate only.

entries.title: Mesa 26.2.5 requires libdrm_amdgpu >= 2.4.133 (meson.build)
entries.pack_action: build/in-container-build.sh checks the snapshot's libdrm before building; mesa-orbis-ps4 depends on libdrm>=2.4.133.

entries.title: Orbis 0.2.0 kernel (feeRnt 108ef97): CHIP_LIVERPOOL gets no pp_smu block in cik.c
entries.pack_action: No power_dpm_force_performance_level / pp_dpm_sclk; profile gpu_perf_level writes are skipped with a recorded reason; pm.clocks UNSUPPORTED.

entries.title: Orbis 0.2.0 kernel: UVD 4.2 and VCE 2.0 IP blocks commented out for Liverpool
entries.pack_action: video.decode UNSUPPORTED (no uvd ring).

entries.title: Loader extracts 8 GPU microcode files; liverpool_uvd.bin / liverpool_vce.bin are not extracted
entries.pack_action: Hardware video would also need private firmware in the initramfs; the pack never ships firmware.

entries.title: aday1 bridge patch: 2 of 8 hunks target ICC delays that crashnt-4.7 already removed
entries.pack_action: kernel/patches/available/0101 (applies -F0; not compile- or boot-tested; defaults = 0.2.0 behaviour).

entries.title: rmuxnet/ps4-linux-12xx not reachable anonymously on 2026-10-26
entries.pack_action: feeRnt carries a 6.18.21-rmuxnet-clean branch (candidate feernt-6.18.21-rmuxnet-clean).

entries.title: linux-psx main moved from a1910182 (Orbis Mesa patch pin) to 21380639
entries.pack_action: Re-diff userspace/mesa/patches against the pinned copies before the next Mesa bump.

entries.title: Community Mesa PKGBUILD (DionKill mesa-ps4) uses sha256sums SKIP
entries.pack_action: Orbis pins every source by commit or SHA-256.

entries.title: Historic recipe (Ps3itaTeam) recommended SigLevel = Never
entries.pack_action: Orbis repos are signed with the local key; the pack's offline pacman config uses the Orbis key when present.

entries.title: 0.2.0 kernel builds without CONFIG_HSA_AMD (no amdkfd): no ROCm/HIP path
entries.pack_action: GPU compute = Vulkan (RADV) and OpenCL (RustiCL) only, both checked with numeric oracles; CPU fallback stays the default AI backend until they pass.
